title: The Ecommerce Affiliate WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not restrict one-time password issuance and verification…
description: The Ecommerce Affiliate WordPress plugin up to version 1.0.0 contains a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to issue and verify one-time passwords without restriction. This flaw enables attackers to take over any user account, including administrator accounts, due to the lack of verification limits and ownership checks.
